name: structural-format-emitters
body: The per-format structure emitters inside the scanner: one emitter per format that turns a parsed file into the format's `Struct`/`contains` records — Markdown headings (`rust.structfrontend.md.build_doc` / `rust.structfrontend.md.parse_headings`), shell functions, YAML keys/jobs/steps, JSON keys, TOML tables/keys, XML elements, Dockerfile stages and instructions, Makefile targets/variables/includes, INI sections/keys. `misc` emits `File` only. The component's other anchors are the scanner's scope-walk helper (`rust.structfrontend.discovery.walk`) and its source line-index helper (`rust.structfrontend.lines.line_count`).
